source: JPL Horizons API, EPHEM_TYPE=OBSERVER, COMMAND=301 (Moon), CENTER=500@399, QUANTITIES=20 (delta = light-time-aberrated geocentric range, AU; deldot km/s), START_TIME=2025-01-01, STOP_TIME=2025-04-01, STEP_SIZE=1h, TIME_TYPE=TT, CAL_FORMAT=JD
method: Perigee (apogee) = parabola through the hourly sample that is a local minimum (maximum) of delta and its two neighbours (Meeus ch. 3 eqs. 3.9–3.10); sub-minute timing for the Moon's smooth range curve. The light-time aberration of delta (≤ 0.1 km) does not move the extremum at this level.
